output.name: Thuskal
output.myth: When the Reel was still tight, the drowned came up out of the Leeward water and stood on the skerries with their arms held out, the way shags stand at low tide to dry their wings. Kael was casting his net for fallen stars that night, as he always does, and caught nothing, but he saw them and came home quiet. They must dry before they can fly north to the Spindle, where Mother Hesk is still winding. Tavo the Gale came over the rocks and laughed, and that is why some of the wings are torn at the edge. The rule is old and plain. If you are out on the water and see the shag-shapes standing on the black rock, do not look long. Turn your face to the mending and count your knots. Hesk keeps count of who looked, and she is patient, and so is the sea.
output.verse:
Wings out on the rock,
the drowned dry in the salt wind,
turn your eyes; don't look.

problems: The right wing star (38089, 'right wing') sits roughly 30px off the gold right-wing line from right shoulder (38917) to right wingtip (36114), so it does not mark the wing edge.
The right wing is a single straight stroke rather than a wing shape; only the left wing has a quadrilateral frame.
The left wing gold lines form a closed quadrilateral (wingtip, leading edge, inner edge, trailing edge) that reads more like a diamond or kite than a feathered wing.
Labels collide: 'left shoulder' overlaps 'left wing inner edge' and 'breast' sits on top of 'left shoulder'; 'head' label crowds the beak-to-breast line.
The blue outline at the bottom (around x 175-330, y 420-450) is a separate flat shape disconnected from the bird, which reads as a base or ground, not part of the silhouette.
Tail tip (38827) is at the bottom of a thin vertical body line, so the body is very narrow compared with the wide wing span.
judge.advice: The figure is upright (beak at top, tail at bottom) and reads as a bird with wings spread, seen from the front, so the blind guess matches. Keep the overall layout. Widen the body slightly around breast 39953 (~246,268) and belly 38957 (~300,325) so the torso reads as a body. Remove or reposition the flat blue shape at the bottom so it does not look like a separate object.
